title: From Principles to Working Safeguards: A Lean Formalization and Analysis of Selected AI-Governance Commitments in Magnifica Humanitas
description: This source-linked study translates selected AI-governance commitments in Magnifica Humanitas §§97-111 into explicit requirements and hypothetical procedures checked in Lean 4. It distinguishes responsibility, appeal, correction power, oversight, participation and performed action. The release includes a six-page public close reading, a one-page illustrated summary, a technical paper with a sourced EU legal comparison, the unchanged formal source suite, ledgers and verification evidence. The models establish conditional results and worked repairs; they do not certify actual institutions. Research, formalization and drafting were supported by ChatGPT (OpenAI); Travis Darshan is responsible for interpretation and presentation.
